info.title: Bullet Trading API
info.description: REST API for the Bullet exchange. Provides Binance FAPI-compatible endpoints for trading, account management, and market data.

get.description:
Superset of `/fapi/v3/balance` that surfaces data the rollup already
returns but the Binance-shaped endpoint doesn't expose:
account-level trading credits, per-asset
gross asset/liability amounts, referral rewards, and perp positions
(with trading_mode / user_selected_max_leverage).

Batch variant of `/api/v1/account`: accepts a comma-separated list of
addresses and returns an array of the same per-account shape, in the same
order as the request. Lets vault callers avoid looping over the single
account endpoint.

200.description: Account balances and positions, one per requested address

404.description: One or more addresses are not accounts; all are named

post.description:
Accepts the JSON envelope produced by the SDK's `solana` / `solanaSimple`
authenticator (Phantom, Solflare, Ledger), where the body is signed with
a Solana off-chain message signature rather than a Sovereign credential.
The rollup verifies the signature and constructs the inner tx; this route
is a pass-through proxy and intentionally skips the borsh tx validator.

get.description:
Every value movement touching the address, newest first: wallet deposits and
withdrawals, moves between cross, spot and isolated buckets, sends to other
accounts or wallets, vault deposits and withdrawals, and Hyperlane bridge
arrivals and departures. Each entry names both sides of the movement.
Referral reward claims are omitted on purpose until the ClaimReferralRewardsV2
event exists.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Account address (required on first request, encoded in cursor for subsequent)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Restrict to one kind of movement, e.g. `DEPOSIT` or `BRIDGE_IN` (optional, case-insensitive)

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Account address (required on first request, encoded in cursor for subsequent)

post.summary: Simulate a transaction against the current rollup state without committing.
post.description:
Pass-through proxy to the sequencer's `/rollup/simulate`. The body is a JSON
`SimulateParameters` document (runtime `call` + `sender`), NOT a signed borsh
tx, so this route intentionally skips the tx validators and forwards the
request unchanged — mirroring the rest of the `/rollup/*` passthrough.

post.summary: Submit a transaction to the rollup.
post.description: Accepts the JSON envelope containing the base64 encoded and borsh serialized transaction.

400.description: Invalid transaction format or validation failed

403.description: Call type not relayed by this API (warp route administration)

address.description: the queried address, echoed back as supplied

generation.description:
highest uniqueness generation this credential has submitted with,
or null if it has never submitted a tx. clients use this to seed a
monotonic generation override so the next tx doesn't collide

window.description:
end of the uniqueness window. clients use this to seed a
monotonic window override so the next tx doesn't collide

ApiErrorDetail.description:
Typed details body. Variant order is important for untagged
deserialization: keep the more-specific shape (`JsonValidation`)
before more-permissive ones. `Upstream` holds the upstream payload
verbatim (object, string, array, number, etc.) so pre-PR clients
reading `details.error` (or `details` directly) keep working.

ApiErrorResponse.description:
Structured API error response matching Bullet API format.

All error responses from the trading API conform to this schema.

oneOf.description: Structured per-failure details. Shape depends on the variant.

marginAvailable.description:
Whether the asset has a configured borrow/lend pool in the margin risk engine.
Funding-only registration does not enable margin use.

isTrigger.description:
bullet extension: true when this row is a user trigger order
(STOP / TAKE_PROFIT). `orderId` for triggers is drawn from the
`TriggerOrderId` namespace, which is independent of the regular
`OrderId` counter — use `(orderId, isTrigger)` as the composite key

oneOf.description:
reserved TP/SL pair attached to this parent limit order. only present
while the parent is unfilled — once filled, the trigger orders are
activated and listed independently

BorrowLendLiquidation.description: borrow-lend specific fields of a `borrow_lend` liquidation

collateralSize.description: liquidatee's collateral balance at liquidation time, not the amount taken

reason.description: The reason the transaction was skipped

adjustedFundingRateCap.description: highest 8h rate this market can reach, i.e. the configured clamp after dampening

adjustedFundingRateFloor.description: lowest 8h rate this market can reach, i.e. the configured clamp after dampening

fundingRate.description: last settled 8h funding rate, dampened by the market's funding dampening multiplier

GlobalVaultConfigResponse.description: Exchange-wide vault policy surfaced from the rollup's active exchange-info version.

status.description: one of: NEW, PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, CANCELED, EXPIRED

JsonValidationErrorDetail.description:
One JSON shape failure: machine-readable `rule` + full serde
message including line/column. Surfaced under `details` on the wire.

message.example: invalid type: integer `24500000`, expected a string at line 4 column 30

detail.description: Structured detail about the revert (`ErrorContext`, an arbitrary JSON object)

SequencerParameter.description: Optional sequencer configuration for a simulation request.

da_address.description: Custom data availability address for the sequencer

rollup_address.description: Custom rollup address for the sequencer

allOf.description: The transaction was skipped due to pre-execution errors.

oneOf.description: The transaction was skipped due to pre-execution errors.

SimulateOutcome.description:
Outcome of a transaction simulation.

Discriminated on `outcome`, mirroring the sequencer's `SimulateOutcome`
(`sov-rollup-apis`): `success` / `reverted` / `skipped`.

SimulateParameters.description:
Parameters for a transaction simulation request.

Mirrors the sequencer's `SimulateParameters`. Documentation-only: like
`/tx/submit`, the handler forwards the raw body, so this type is not
deserialized in-process.

call.description: The runtime call to simulate, provided as JSON

sender.description: The credential ID of the transaction sender

uniqueness.description: Optional uniqueness data for the transaction

SimulatedEvent.description: An event emitted during transaction simulation.

module.description: The module that emitted the event

SubmitSolanaOffchainTxRequest.description:
Body for a Solana off-chain signed transaction.

Produced by the bullet SDK's `solana` / `solanaSimple` authenticators
(Phantom, Solflare, Ledger). The inner bytes are a Solana off-chain
signed message, NOT a borsh-serialized Sovereign tx.

body.description: Base64-encoded Solana off-chain signed message envelope

gas_used.description: Gas consumed by the transaction (gas-token amount, as a decimal string)

priority_fee.description: Priority fee paid (gas-token amount, as a decimal string)

orderType.description:
LIMIT (bullet's TPSL legs are always limit orders — see `time_in_force`
for the actual TIF behaviour)

timeInForce.description:
GTC | GTX (post-only) | FOK | IOC — matches the parent BinanceOrder's
`timeInForce` shape

triggerOrderId.description: the reserved TriggerOrderId this leg will activate as

TransferEndpoint.description: one side of a user transfer

address.description: account or wallet address, absent for the remote side of a bridge movement

vaultName.description: vault name when `bucket` is `VAULT` and the vault is known

coverage.description: FULL if rollup `size` was NULL (close-position trigger), else PARTIAL

workingType.description:
MARK_PRICE | ORACLE_PRICE | LAST_PRICE — preserves rollup granularity
(see compat_helpers::trigger_price_condition_display)

TwapFill.description: Fully linked TWAP slice fill for `/fapi/v1/twapFills`.

TxDetailsParameter.description: Optional transaction details for a simulation request.

gas_limit.description: Gas limit for the transaction, as an array of u64 values

max_fee.description: Maximum fee the sender is willing to pay

max_priority_fee_bips.description: Maximum priority fee in basis points
